description: PRESENTATION SMUGGLING: the agent cannot reach the stylesheet, so it tries to reach the reader instead — embedding markup and inline styles inside contract text fields to colour its own finding and inject a banner. ADR-0016 makes the renderer the sole owner of presentation; a report whose appearance varies with what an agent typed into `summary` is no longer the same document from every agent. The renderer escapes this markup, so it cannot execute — but it renders as visible angle brackets in the report, and the attempt itself is the defect being caught here.

input.scenario: The agent decorates its own findings, having been told the renderer owns presentation.

findings.title: CRITICAL — Checkout fails
findings.expected: The order is submitted and the confirmation page loads.
findings.repro:
1. Add an item
2. Open /checkout
3. Click Pay
